record.text: The engineering team uses TypeScript, Vitest, strict ESM imports, and small pull requests for service work.
Customer-facing incidents should include a short impact summary, rollback status, and the next owner.
Developer agent should run npm run typecheck, npm test, and npm run build before handing off changes.
Dashboard changes live in src/control/web.ts. Keep the browser UI dependency-free and backed by /api/dashboard.
QA agent validates regression coverage, edge cases, and whether metrics remain honest under filtering.
Documentation should explain baselineTokens, injectedTokens, savedTokens, and the quality validation loop.
